items.title: Somalia: Somali Army Commander, Turkey-Trained Troops Welcomed in Mogadishu
items.description: [Shabelle] Mogadishu -- Somalia's 21st Gorgor Commando Brigade commander and a contingent of Somali soldiers who completed advanced military training in Turkey have been welcomed at a ceremony in Mogadishu, the military said Wednesday.

items.title: Egypt TV presenter Sarah Khalifa sentenced to death in drug case
items.description: Egyptian television presenter Sarah Khalifa and 11 other people have been sentenced to death after being convicted of drug trafficking and other offences, state-owned Al-Ahram reported.
items.titleIt: Egypt TV presenter Sarah Khalifa sentenced to death in drug case

items.title: Somali piracy surges as the impact of the US-Iran war ripples outwards
items.description: Two ships were seized within four days last week raising to at least 13 the number attacked since January.
items.titleIt: Somali piracy surges as the impact of the US-Iran war ripples outwards

items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.
items.titleIt: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.
items.titleIt: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran

items.title: Kenya: Govt Deploys Automatic Terminal Information Service At JKIA to Improve Management of Arriving, Departing Flights
items.description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The government is tightening operational and security controls at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA), deploying new flight-information and passenger-data systems as it seeks to improve processing, strengthen oversight and curb irregular baggage handling.
items.titleIt: Kenya: Govt Deploys Automatic Terminal Information Service At JKIA to Improve Management of Arriving, Departing Flights

items.title: Concerns over wildlife, water supply, as wildfire rages across Mount Kenya
items.description: A wildfire has burned about 8,700 hectares of vegetation on Mount Kenya since the fire was first reported on Sept 1, Mount Kenya Trust, an environmental conservation group, said.

items.title: Mattarella and Estonian counterpart Karis confirm support for Kyiv
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 07 SET - President Sergio Mattarella met his Estonian counterpart Alar Karis at the Quirinal Palace in Rome on Monday in a meeting in which the two heads of State confirmed their support for Ukraine. The leaders also expressed the hope that "the ongoing negotiations will bring results". The two presidents discussed European integration, defence, Gaza, Israel and migration too. (ANSA).
